resolvedBlocker.reason: analyzer.schemaMismatch: trace-analysis@1 produced JSON outside ArkTrace analysis contract 1.0
rejectedRules: validateSchedulingSample required latencyNs == runningStartNs - runnableEndNs; real runnable interval ends exactly at running start, so the pre-fix rule demanded 0 while the real latency was 670000
validateSectionStatus required matchedCount == returnedCount || truncated; real threadStateDistribution aggregates 3108 source rows into 434 returned rows without truncation
resolvedBlocker.resolution: rebuilt arkdeck-agentd from ArkDeck HEAD, assembled ArkDeckAgent.app per Distribution/macOS/build-helpers.sh layout, signed with Developer ID + hardened runtime + ArkDeckAgent.entitlements reusing the existing embedded provisioning profile, then arkdeck agentd update

resolvedSigningBlocker.gate10: closed by the real loop recorded in phase6-real-debug-loop.json
resolvedSigningBlocker.resolution: refreshed the signing receipt field trustedDaemonApplicationSHA256 to the rebuilt daemon's fingerprint, which is exactly what refreshDaemonKeychainIdentity writes when the keychain access schema is already current; the operation returned to available and signed both Phase 6 HAPs
resolvedSigningBlocker.mechanism: the OpenHarmony signing receipt binds trustedDaemonApplicationSHA256 = SHA256("arkdeck-keychain-trusted-application-v1\0" || kSecCodeInfoUnique || SHA256(executable)); replacing the daemon changes it, so validateTrustedDaemonIdentity raises identityDrift
resolvedSigningBlocker.supportedRepairNeeds: arkdeck agentd update runs refreshDaemonKeychainIdentity, which needs a CLI entitled for keychain group 8AQTYW5FKR.com.arkdeck.shared; a bare SwiftPM arkdeck cannot read it, and signing that entitlement without a provisioning profile makes the process SIGKILL at launch. An ArkDeckCLI.app with an 8AQTYW5FKR.com.arkdeck.cli provisioning profile is required and is not present on this machine

equivalentOneLineRepair.knownAnswerTestPassed: an independent reimplementation of daemonFingerprint reproduced the receipt's existing value exactly from the pre-update daemon binary

resolvedSigningBlocker.note: DP Keychain access is granted by access group + team, which is stable across signed helper updates; this field is ArkDeck's own fail-closed bookkeeping, not an OS ACL

correction.earlierClaim: the blocker required repairing an ArkDeck.xcodeproj duplicate-product misconfiguration
correction.actual: the signed helper is produced by Packages/ArkDeckKit/Distribution/macOS/build-helpers.sh, not by any Xcode target. The Xcode error is a separate, unrelated Release/Debug asymmetry: Debug defines ROCKCHIP_COMPONENT_INPUT = /usr/bin/false and Release does not, and CI passes it on the command line. Left unchanged.
